player_storylines.note: Only recorded appearances; absences are not identified as injuries. GK clean sheets use full-match team goals conceded and at least 60 minutes.

state.note: Pass/defensive totals shown only for completed halves; shot counts update live.

league_expectations.basis: Fixed synthetic competitive-tier position ranges, not statistical forecasts
league_expectations.standings_tiebreakers: Points, goal difference, goals for, team name

historical_context.evidence_note: All aggregates come from historical synthetic matches. Rates are descriptive, not predictions. Source match IDs are included for traceability.

form_field_semantics.recent_form: Featured home team's overall recent matches
form_field_semantics.home_form: Featured home team's matches played at home only
form_field_semantics.away_form: Featured home team's matches played away only; NOT featured away team's form
form_field_semantics.opponent_recent_form: Featured away team's overall recent matches

substitution_comparisons.interpretation: Higher historical scenario-relative suitability; not a predicted in-match performance gain.

home.note: Rankings are historical position-relative scores, not win probabilities. Position-for-position options only; goalkeeper suggestions excluded.

evidence_provenance.phase_data_policy: Only snapshot/event observations through current minute; passing and defending totals only from completed halves.

ai_instructions.grounding: Use only this JSON. Never claim events not present in observed_events.
ai_instructions.uncertainty: Treat historical rates as descriptive, not forecasts.
ai_instructions.recent_form_mapping: For comparisons of the two featured teams, exclusively use team_recent_form.home.recent_form for the home team and team_recent_form.away.recent_form for the away team. historical_context.away_form is the home team's away-venue split, NOT the featured away team's form.
ai_instructions.narrative_focus: Preview team form, starting XI and available tactical options; do not mention score.
